5064	    k = len(label_list)

5066	    result = pivoted[: start + 1]
5067	    prev = pivoted[start]
5068	
5069	    for cur in pivoted[start + 1 :]:
5070	        sparse_cur = []
5071	
5072	        for i, (p, t) in enumerate(zip(prev, cur, strict=True)):
5073	            if i == k - 1:
5074	                sparse_cur.append(t)

5076	                break
